description: An Elderly Caretaker (Non-Clinical) in the informal sector is one of the most crucial operational roles in the domestic worker segment where the caretaker would be providing care to an elderly person who may or may not have any disability. The primary role of the elderly caretaker is to assist elderly person in day to day activities such as walking eating, dressing, toileting, grooming and in running errands. She/ he would also assist the elderly with in cooking and housekeeping duties. Creation and maintenance of a hygienic and pleasant environment for the elderly would also be a part of her/ his duties
